images.author: Eszter Kisgyura
images.why: Best match: white-sailed felucca on the blue Nile at Aswan, with greenery and the sandy Tombs of the Nobles hillside. Strong colour and recognisable setting; 3000px CDN version.

images.author: Chris Andrawes
images.why: White-sailed felucca on the Nile at Aswan; a prominent, simple focal point for a near-square crop. Camera photograph; 3000px CDN version.

images.author: Gijs Jakobs
images.why: Felucca sailing on the Nile at Aswan at sunset. Atmospheric alternative with warm evening colour; 3000px CDN version.

images.author: Marcos Amend/Shutterstock
images.why: Classic aerial Meeting of Waters at Manaus: broad brown Solimões meets dark Rio Negro beside green forest. Published editorial image, not a watermarked agency preview; native resolution unverified.

images.author: Marcos Colón
images.why: Documentary aerial titled “No Way to Get Lost,” explicitly identified as the Solimões River in Brazil, photographed in March 2020. Strong provenance; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: David Leffman
images.why: Classic Qutang Gorge view: the Yangtze and a boat framed by towering cliffs. Strong central river corridor for a 9:10 crop; misty rather than vivid blue-sky conditions. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: xiaoxian
images.why: Tiger Leaping Gorge with dramatic cliffs and the rushing upper Yangtze clearly featured. Verified 4000 × 6000 camera photograph; portrait orientation is the main compromise.

images.author: Kenny Nguyễn
images.why: St. Louis skyline and Gateway Arch viewed across the Mississippi at blue hour. Recognisable landmark, foreground water and evening lights; 3000px CDN version.

images.author: Kenny Nguyễn
images.why: Alternative blue-hour composition of the illuminated Gateway Arch beside the Mississippi. Strong landmark silhouette for the poster card; 3000px CDN version.

images.author: Zaq24
images.why: Best landscape match: elevated summer view of the broad Yenisey at Divnogorsk, with forested hills and the town along its banks. Original-content post; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Дмитрий Кирюхин
images.why: Explicitly identified Yenisey riverfront at Divnogorsk, with green forested cliffs across the water. Softer, overcast alternative; 2500px-bounded image URL, actual dimensions unverified.
